title: Exact Maximum Coalitional Influence
statement: Let $w>0$, and consider the critical tribes Boolean function on its critical dimension, with target value $-1$. Every set $J$ of at most $w$ coordinates has coalitional influence toward $-1$ at most $1/2+d_w$, where $d_w$ is the function's probability deficit from $1/2$; moreover, there is a set of exactly $w$ coordinates attaining this bound.
hypotheses_covered: Block width $w$ is a natural number
The coordinate set has size at most $w$
There exists a maximizing coordinate set of size exactly $w$
